tools.name: manufacturing-quality_production-inspection-parse
tools.description: Copy supplied inspections, measurements, batches, and standards into a consistent packet with pass/fail outcomes. Tolerances are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/manufacturing-quality/production-inspection-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: manufacturing-quality_defect-classify
tools.description: Classify failed inspections with transparent token rules such as dimensional, surface, assembly, material, or functional. Classification is not a certification. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/manufacturing-quality/defect-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: manufacturing-quality_defect-rate-calculate
tools.description: Calculate defect rate from decided pass/fail inspections and compare it with an explicitly supplied threshold. Small samples are disclosed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/manufacturing-quality/defect-rate-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: manufacturing-quality_batch-compare
tools.description: Compare batch defect rates only when each batch meets the disclosed sample minimum. Rate differences are not treated as regulatory findings. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/manufacturing-quality/batch-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: manufacturing-quality_nonconformance-report-generate
tools.description: Assemble structured nonconformance rows from failed inspections with linked measurements and evidence ids. The report does not claim certification or compliance. Price $0.05 USDC. tools.description: Compare supplied measurements with caller-supplied lower and upper limits. SPC mean±3σ limits are computed only when the disclosed observation minimum is met. Price $0.05 USDC. tools.name: manufacturing-quality_root-cause-evidence-analyze
tools.description: Link supplied evidence rows to failed inspections by id and summarize evidence kinds. Links are associations in the request, not proven root causes. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/manufacturing-quality/root-cause-evidence-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Combine inspection parsing, defect classes, defect rates, batch comparisons, tolerances, NCR rows, and evidence links from supplied records. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "manufacturing-quality" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: manufacturing-quality_production-tolerance-check · Private data: manufacturing-quality_defect-classify, manufacturing-quality_report · Public sink: manufacturing-quality_production-inspection-parse, manufacturing-quality_defect-classify, manufacturing-quality_defect-rate-calculate, manufacturing-quality_batch-compare, manufacturing-quality_nonconformance-report-generate, manufacturing-quality_production-tolerance-check, manufacturing-quality_root-cause-evidence-analyze, manufacturing-quality_report · Destructive: manufacturing-quality_production-inspection-parse, manufacturing-quality_defect-classify, manufacturing-quality_defect-rate-calculate, manufacturing-quality_batch-compare, manufacturing-quality_nonconformance-report-generate, manufacturing-quality_production-tolerance-check, manufacturing-quality_root-cause-evidence-analyze, manufacturing-quality_report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
